residual_risks: An adopted daemon from an older app version does not have the new shutdown endpoint. Its first clean quit after upgrade falls back to the 15-second lease expiry and 180-second idle grace.
The packaged Electron restart and updater flows were verified structurally and by unit tests, but not through a packaged GUI smoke run.
testing_gaps: No packaged GUI smoke run was performed for restart, update installation, or deliberate quit.
